name: Cataracts of Sabella
title: Cataracts of Sabella
summary: A cascade of giant waterfalls on Lotila Island at 82.7N 74.7W. An upper lake (z 110) spills over a 127 m west curtain and a 130 m north curtain, 30 m down into a middle lake and a north lake (z 80). Those two lakes fall another 30 m north and west into a lower lake (z 50). The kit holds 65 lip spray emitters and 52 foot spray emitters along the four curtains.

landmarks.name: Lower falls
landmarks.note: Middle and north lakes (z 80) fall to the lowest lake (z 50) along y ~44340 and x ~6520.

shots.standingOrder: Hold 22 m above the middle lake 95 m west of the upper cataract and pan slowly right from the lower falls pouring north to the 127 m white curtain of the upper falls, lit by the afternoon sun behind the lens.
shots.notes: Signature view. A locked pan 22 m above the middle lake, 95 m west of the upper cataract. It pans 38 deg right from the lower falls pouring north to the 127 m white curtain of the upper falls, front-lit by the afternoon sun behind the lens. The camera stays 100 % over water. shots.standingOrder: Rise from 3 m over the lowest lake past the lip of the lower falls until the north lake and the upper cataract behind it appear; keep 9 m from the spray line.
shots.notes: Rising reveal. The camera starts 3 m above the lowest lake, facing the lower falls 38 m away and 9 m from their foot spray line.
